youtube.title: Why Doctors Said ORS Could Never Work (Until 1971)
youtube.description: In 1971, cholera ripped through refugee camps near Bongaon and the hospital saline ran out. One young Indian doctor tried something every textbook said would fail. The hidden why behind the ORS packet in your medicine cabinet: sugar helps the gut pull in salt and water, even while cholera is draining the body. It has since saved millions of lives. #TheHiddenWhy #facts #explained

sources: The Lancet, 5 August 1978, editorial 'Water with sugar and salt' (called ORT potentially the most important medical advance of the century)
Mahalanabis D. et al., 'Oral fluid therapy of cholera among Bangladesh refugees', Johns Hopkins Medical Journal, 1973
WHO fact sheet and UNICEF/WHO ORS guidance on oral rehydration salts and diarrhoeal disease
BBC News and Nature obituaries of Dr Dilip Mahalanabis, October 2022
FSSAI order of October 2025 restricting 'ORS' labelling on drinks not matching the WHO formula
